# Sentry

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 3 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Dense monitoring dashboards, trace waterfalls, diagnostic tables, query builders and filters.

Captured 2026-10-31, signed-in owner account; no trial activated; tier unverified. Themes: light, dark.

Live Sentry web-app capture from the owner's 10xswe organization on 2026-10-31, plus a separately labelled public landing-page capture. The app supplied a populated trace explorer, span attributes and waterfall, but no issues across all statuses over 30 days. No trial was activated; account billing tier was not verified.

App screenshots measure 1065 CSS pixels wide (visual viewport 1065.56), about 959 high, DPR 1.8; native JPEG screenshots are 1065 or 1066 pixels wide. Requested 1440/390 overrides had no effect during the app capture. Public landing evidence measures 1440 and 390 CSS pixels. Both live app themes were captured. The approved temporary light setting was restored to Default to system.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Coverage is partial. No app primitive ramps, complete status palette, spacing scale, breakpoints, reduced-motion rules, hover/pressed variants or mobile app layout were captured. The accent token is selected-tab text, not primary-button fill. Transparent controls use surrounding paint layers; do not interpret a transparent computed background as the rendered face. Control dimensions retain fractional computed values under browser scaling. Feedback's shadow DOM is screenshot-only. The font-loading reader was unavailable; computed font-family is evidence of the declared stack, not proof every fallback was used. One span image intentionally records loading; it is not accepted as loaded diagnostics. Scrollable attribute panels show their visible top portion.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep navigation in separate columns.** Preserve the narrow global rail and wider section sidebar shown in [trace explorer](screenshots/app/traces-dark-list.png); do not fold both levels into an undifferentiated list.
- **Keep filters close to the data.** Project, environment and date controls precede the query field in [issues](screenshots/app/issues-dark-empty.png); do not move them away from their results.
- **Use aligned data rows for scanning.** The [trace table](screenshots/app/traces-light-list.png) aligns fields and durations; do not replace diagnostic rows with large decorative cards.
- **Keep diagnostic context beside selection.** The [waterfall](screenshots/app/trace-dark-waterfall.png) shows the selected span and attributes together; do not discard the trace when opening a span.
- **Keep marketing evidence separate.** The [public hero](screenshots/public/landing-desktop.png) is illustrative; do not treat its embedded dashboards as app states or use its palette as app tokens.
